# Pitboard

> Switch AI coding accounts and see their usage.

Pitboard switches Claude Code and OpenAI's Codex CLI on macOS, Windows and Linux, and Claude Desktop on macOS.

Install the command line on macOS or Linux:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://usepitboard.com/install.sh | sh
```

On Windows, install the app, which includes the command line, from [Download Pitboard](https://usepitboard.com/download#windows).
